exclusions: Every lead and candidate in prior immutable requests through 2026-08-11 was excluded, including Developer, VNNN., Orion Mindworks, pranch, GI-RO47, Lizoto, Sabrj and Slaveone.
All 26 ledger identities, durable rejected entries, frozen Session 4 material, protected opening and ending, and untriggered PARKED revisit entries were excluded.

Current-release alternatives were excluded when descriptions emphasized peak-time impact, relentless pressure, vocal or melodic dominance, or supplied only release-level style language without a track-level restrained-behaviour hypothesis.

Adjacent and emerging alternatives were excluded when house, melodic, euphoric, high-energy, or direct-impact framing outweighed patient functional progression, or when the likely role was already fully occupied.

Overlooked catalogue alternatives were excluded when their metadata required a protected/frozen placement, their exact identity was ambiguous, or their evidence supported only genre, BPM, popularity, or dancefloor intent.
No lead was admitted for novelty, popularity, duration, BPM, artist reputation, label reputation, or quota completion.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.
